sources.snippet: Meta also says the model is not intended for people under 18 and lists prohibited uses in its Usage Policy. Who should use Muse Glimmer 30B? Use it if you already have 24-32GB hardware and want a local coding, research or personal-agent model with vision, long context and a first-party GGUF path.
